text.title: Agency Pricing Tiers Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the good / better / best rate sheet and its playbook step: exactly three priced tiers in order, each with price, delivery cost (hours, loaded hourly cost, pass-through) and gross margin, deliverables with quantity and turnaround forming strict supersets, prices on the 3 / 5 / 8 shape within 15 percent or a named scope justification, the fence the good tier omits, better as the default recommendation, best-first presentation with visible prices, the documented scope-up procedure, concessions by scope only, and the rollout steps. Validator at scripts/validate-agency-pricing-tiers.py enforces it, including the margin, ratio and superset arithmetic.

required.field: ISO 4217 code all prices and costs are in

exactly three, named good, better, best in that order; each with `price`, `delivery_cost` (`hours`, `loaded_hourly_cost`, `pass_through`), `gross_margin_abs` = price minus cost, `gross_margin_pct`, and `deliverables[]` with `quantity` and `turnaround_days` (r-exactly-three-priced-tiers, r-best-tier-highest-margin, r-tiers-are-strict-supersets)
`omitted_deliverable` the good tier lacks and better has, `needed_for` the ICP outcome, `named_on_rate_sheet: true` (r-good-tier-fenced-middle-tier-complete)
`trigger`, `price_rule` (tier price difference pro-rated to the remaining term), `approver`, `written_confirmation_required: true`, `free_goodwill_allowed: false` (r-scope-up-procedure-documented)

rollout steps with `id`, `name`, `exit_criterion`, `output_location`; a price gap outside the 3 / 5 / 8 band is justified there by the `gap_justification.scope_difference` text (r-price-gaps-follow-3-5-8)
`scope_difference` naming the deliverable difference that explains a gap outside the band (r-price-gaps-follow-3-5-8)

forbidden.pattern: a best tier whose `gross_margin_abs` or `gross_margin_pct` is not the highest of the three — best-tier-lowest-margin
better / good outside 1.42-1.92 or best / better outside 1.36-1.84 with no `gap_justification` echoed in a step's `exit_criterion` — equal-price-steps
a deliverable in good missing from better, or in better missing from best, or carried with a lower quantity or slower turnaround — tiers-swap-instead-of-nest
`scope_up.free_goodwill_allowed: true`, or a scope-up with no approver or no written confirmation — silent-scope-creep
`concessions.published_prices_vary_by_client: true`, or a concession method other than removing scope — per-client-price-discounts
`presentation.order` not best, better, good, or `prices_visible: false` — lead-with-cheapest
a fourth priced tier, or tiers out of good / better / best order — r-exactly-three-priced-tiers
`fence.omitted_deliverable` present in good or absent from better, or `default_recommendation` other than better — r-good-tier-fenced-middle-tier-complete

list.item: Exactly three tiers, in the order good, better, best, each with a visible price (r-exactly-three-priced-tiers).
Every tier's `gross_margin_abs` = `price` - (`hours` x `loaded_hourly_cost` + `pass_through`), `gross_margin_pct` = abs / price, and best leads on both (r-best-tier-highest-margin).

better / good is within 1.42-1.92 and best / better within 1.36-1.84, or `gap_justification.scope_difference` names the deliverable difference and a step's `exit_criterion` repeats it (r-price-gaps-follow-3-5-8).
Every deliverable in good is in better and every one in better is in best, with quantity equal or higher and turnaround equal or faster (r-tiers-are-strict-supersets).
`fence.omitted_deliverable` is absent from good, present in better, named on the rate sheet; `default_recommendation` is better (r-good-tier-fenced-middle-tier-complete).
`scope_up` states trigger, the pro-rated price rule, an approver and written confirmation; free goodwill is not allowed (r-scope-up-procedure-documented).
Concessions remove named scope; published prices do not vary by client (r-discount-by-scope-not-price).
`presentation.order` is best, better, good with prices visible (r-present-best-first).

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the margin, ratio and superset arithmetic.
